about: Interval overlap beside the direction probability: v1 L-06's view of two units with equal SDs (SD 1, B's posterior mean 0). The read-out gives the level, the distance between the posterior means and the probability that A's true value is larger than B's; the pair card gives the four interval ends, the status, the same probability, the SD of the difference and the distance in SDs of the difference; the lower figure's key gives the probability again. Ported from v1 (cases touch90, touch95, touch-gap2) with the keys of the league view dropped from the queries (mode, pair, prior_sd: the league view is app 1.12, whose cases moved with it) and the caption in its v3 wording. Interval ends at the touching point are base-R oracle quantiles (oracle-special); distances, probabilities, the SD of the difference (1.414) and the distance in its SDs come from v1's frozen registry (cf.touch.*). New in v3: the probabilities at distances 1 and 2 from base-R oracle rows of pairDirection (oracle-pairwise; pairDirection(1, 1, 0, 1) and (2, 1, 0, 1)); the distance 3.25, where the probability equals that of sites D and E of postrank 1.1.0's pr_tutorial (posterior means .15 and −.50, SD .20 each: 3.25 posterior SDs apart), from the golden postrank 1.1.0 row of that error array; the touching distance followed when the level changes; the apart wording. The overlap amounts, the distance 4.5 and the touch distance of a raw slider value have no independent source in these files: the general rules read their displays back.
